name: note_ends_up_on_the_sheet
why: ENTRY E2-bis. A workshop drawing is not made only of geometry and dimensions: it carries the general notes — «break all sharp edges», «galvanise after welding», «unspecified tolerances ISO 2768-mK». Up to 0.100.0 the bridge could not write even one.
_why_the_count_is_in_TWO_places: `InsertNote` writes on the **SHEET**, but `GetNoteCount()` lives on `IView` — and the true views of a drawing begin AFTER the first, because **the first «view» is the sheet**. Whoever counted only the true views would read `0 -> 0` with the note regularly in its place, and would write «not even the notes are born: it is a systemic block». That false negative would have closed by mistake four entries of the TODO (surface finish, datum, welds, GD&T), all unblocked precisely by the fact that a note is born.
defect_caught: A note that is born in the wrong place, or with a text different from the one asked for. That is why the case is not satisfied with `notes_placed`: it demands that **the views stay at zero** — which is what says WHERE it ended up — and that the text **re-read by SOLIDWORKS** contain the string asked for. A text copied from the one given as input would prove nothing: it would always match.

expect.why: the plate that then goes on the drawing: if the part is not the right one, neither is the drawing
a drawing is made on a saved part: if the save warns, the view might point to a file that is not there
from here on the active document is another one, and it is the condition for all the rest

the views are not needed by the note — which goes on the sheet — but they are needed by the COUNTERPART: without views, «the views stay at zero» would be true for lack of views instead of because the note is in the right place
how many were BORN, counted before and after — not how many times I called the API. The value that comes back from whoever did the thing is not the measure of the thing

expect._and_this_says_WHERE: **THE COUNTERPART, and it is the piece that makes the entry worth it.** `notes_placed` at 1 would be green even if the note had ended up inside a view — and a note inside a view moves together with the view, which on a drawing is a real defect. Three views are there (previous step) and stay at zero: the note is on the sheet.
expect.why: says on which of the two counters the measure went up

**the text RE-READ by SOLIDWORKS**, not the one I thought I had asked for. A note that appears with a different text reads like a right note until somebody compares it: on paper it is a line of text like the others
the counterpart of the re-read: if one day this one were green and the one above red, it would be known at once that the problem is in the writing and not in the case
the position re-read from the object, not the one set: a note that ends up elsewhere exists, is counted, and may not be on the paper

expect._the_first_draft_searched_for_lowercase_: And the run saw it red: the answer says «be TRUE» in capitals, and `contiene` is case-sensitive. The defect was in the expectation, not in the operation — but from outside the two are written the same, and for twenty minutes I looked at the right code. Now the expectation looks for **«free text»**, which in the sentence is in lower case because it is prose and not an emphasis: an expectation hung on a word that somebody might decide to shout is an expectation hung on punctuation.
expect.why: the blindness travels with the answer: the operation guarantees that the note is there and says what you wrote, not that it is right to write it. «Material S355» on an S275 part passes every count and every re-read
